title: 超濾膜前處理~Ultrafiltration pretreatment
focus: UF 進水預處理、通量、完整性與淨產水~UF feed conditioning, flux, integrity and net production
summary: 本課以UF 進水預處理、通量、完整性與淨產水為主線，從進水組成與孔徑邊界、攔截與預處理試驗、膜面積與通量、跨膜壓與壓力量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops uf feed conditioning, flux, integrity and net production through ten connected units, beginning with feed constituents and separation boundary, screening and pretreatment trials, membrane area and flux, transmembrane pressure measurement. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 進水組成與孔徑邊界~Feed constituents and separation boundary
units.mechanism: 區分懸浮顆粒、膠體、溶解鹽與有機物；UF 不會因為水變清就把所有溶解物去掉。~Separate particles, colloids, dissolved salts and organics; clarified UF permeate does not imply removal of all dissolved species.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「進水組成與孔徑邊界」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed constituents and separation boundary. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以低濁度宣稱已完成脫鹽。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。~Low turbidity is used to claim desalination. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
units.misconception: 超濾膜是所有溶解物的絕對屏障。~UF is an absolute barrier to all dissolved substances.
units.practice: 只改變 Cout:20→30 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「進水組成與孔徑邊界」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cout:20→30 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using feed constituents and separation boundary, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 攔截與預處理試驗~Screening and pretreatment trials
units.mechanism: 預處理要保護纖維與流道；混凝等方案需測對通量、殘餘物與清洗相容性的影響。~Pretreatment protects fibers/channels; coagulation options require tests of flux, residuals and cleaning compatibility.
units.model: 原創教學假設：原水濁度=50 NTU；沉降後=5 NTU。模型 ηT=(T0-T)/T0，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：濁度指標不是污染物質量或病原去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: Raw turbidity=50 NTU; settled turbidity=5 NTU. Model ηT=(T0-T)/T0 gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Turbidity reduction is not contaminant mass or pathogen removal.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「攔截與預處理試驗」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for screening and pretreatment trials. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看出水濁度而漏掉膜阻力快速上升。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。~Effluent turbidity is checked while rapidly rising membrane resistance is missed. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
units.misconception: 混凝產生越多絮體就一定越適合所有 UF。~More coagulation floc always benefits every UF system.
units.practice: 只改變 T:5→8 NTU，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.9 變為 0.84 fraction。用「攔截與預處理試驗」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T:5→8 NTU, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.9 to 0.84 fraction. Explain the direction using screening and pretreatment trials, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 膜面積與通量~Membrane area and flux
units.mechanism: 通量用產水除有效膜面積，並標明在線面積；同一總產水下停用膜組會提高其他膜負擔。~Flux is permeate per effective online area; taking trains offline raises loading on the remaining area at equal output.
units.model: 原創教學假設：透過流量=10 m³/h；膜面積=200 m²。模型 J=1000Qp/A，代入得到 50 L/(m²·h)。適用邊界：淨產水與瞬時過濾通量須分別報告；反洗停機不包含在瞬時值。~Original teaching assumptions: Permeate flow=10 m³/h; membrane area=200 m². Model J=1000Qp/A gives 50 L/(m²·h). Applicability: Report net production separately from instantaneous flux, which excludes backwash downtime.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「膜面積與通量」的觀測點。核對膜面積、流量及完整循環時間。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for membrane area and flux. Check membrane area, flow and full cycle time. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以安裝總面積掩蓋停用膜組。診斷與介入：改用在線有效面積重算，配對反洗停機與淨產水。~Installed area is used to hide offline trains. Diagnostic response: Recalculate using online effective area and account for washing downtime/net output.
units.misconception: 相同產水量代表每支膜承受相同負荷。~Equal permeate output implies equal loading on each membrane.
units.practice: 只改變 Qp:10→12 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 50 變為 60 L/(m²·h)。用「膜面積與通量」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qp:10→12 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 50 to 60 L/(m²·h). Explain the direction using membrane area and flux, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 跨膜壓與壓力量測~Transmembrane pressure measurement
units.mechanism: 依流道定義取進水、濃水及產水壓力；單一入口壓力不一定是 TMP。~Use feed, concentrate and permeate pressures for the specified flow configuration; inlet pressure alone is not necessarily TMP.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進水壓=1.2 bar；濃水壓=0.8 bar；透過側=0.1 bar。模型 TMP=(Pf+Pr)/2-Pp，代入得到 0.9 bar。適用邊界：簡化沿程平均；壓力取點與靜水頭須一致。~Original teaching assumptions: Feed pressure=1.2 bar; concentrate=0.8 bar; permeate=0.1 bar. Model TMP=(Pf+Pr)/2-Pp gives 0.9 bar. Applicability: Simplified axial mean; tap elevations and hydrostatic head must be consistent.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「跨膜壓與壓力量測」的觀測點。校正三個壓力點，並記錄取壓高程。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for transmembrane pressure measurement. Calibrate all three pressure points and record their elevations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 忽略產水背壓而高估驅動力。診斷與介入：校正三個壓力點及高程，確認所用膜流道定義。~Permeate backpressure is ignored, overstating driving force. Diagnostic response: Calibrate the three pressure points/elevations and confirm membrane-flow configuration.
units.misconception: 進水壓力就是所有 UF 系統的跨膜壓。~Feed pressure is TMP in every UF system.
units.practice: 只改變 Pf:1.2→1.4 bar，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.9 變為 1 bar。用「跨膜壓與壓力量測」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Pf:1.2→1.4 bar, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.9 to 1 bar. Explain the direction using transmembrane pressure measurement, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 滲透率與溫度正規化~Permeability and temperature normalization
units.mechanism: 通量除 TMP 有助判讀阻力，但需配對水溫與模式，才能區分黏度變動與污染。~Flux/TMP helps assess resistance, but temperature and mode must be matched to distinguish viscosity changes from fouling.
units.model: 原創教學假設：J=50 L/(m²·h)；TMP=0.5 bar。模型 Lp=J/TMP，代入得到 100 L/(m²·h·bar)。適用邊界：需先溫度校正；通透率下降可能是污染、黏度或量測偏差。~Original teaching assumptions: J=50 L/(m²·h); TMP=0.5 bar. Model Lp=J/TMP gives 100 L/(m²·h·bar). Applicability: Temperature correction is needed; decline may reflect fouling, viscosity or sensor bias.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「滲透率與溫度正規化」的觀測點。同溫度比較清洗前後通透率與壓差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for permeability and temperature normalization. Compare pre/post-cleaning permeability and pressure loss at matching temperatures. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 冬季通量降低直接判斷不可逆污染。診斷與介入：配對溫度與 TMP，再區分可逆污染及不可逆變化。~Reduced winter flux is immediately labeled irreversible fouling. Diagnostic response: Match temperature/TMP before separating reversible fouling from irreversible change.
units.misconception: 滲透率變動只能由膜破損造成。~Only membrane damage can change permeability.
units.practice: 只改變 TMP:0.5→0.7 bar，其餘假設固定；結果應由 100 變為 71.428571 L/(m²·h·bar)。用「滲透率與溫度正規化」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TMP:0.5→0.7 bar, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 100 to 71.428571 L/(m²·h·bar). Explain the direction using permeability and temperature normalization, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 反洗與淨水量~Backwashing and net water balance
units.mechanism: 毛產水扣掉反洗、排放與完整性測試耗水，才是可交付產水；回收不得重複計數。~Subtract backwash, drains and integrity-test water from gross permeate to obtain deliverable water without double-counting recycle.
units.model: 原創教學假設：UF 毛產水=240 m³/d；反洗=12、排放=8 m³/d。模型 Qnet=Qgross-Qbw-Qdrain，代入得到 220 m³/d。適用邊界：同一日與同一膜組邊界，旁流回收不能重複算作新產水。~Original teaching assumptions: UF gross permeate=240 m³/d; backwash=12, drain loss=8 m³/d. Model Qnet=Qgross-Qbw-Qdrain gives 220 m³/d. Applicability: Same day and membrane-train boundary; recycled sidestreams must not be counted twice as new production.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「反洗與淨水量」的觀測點。以各支線累積水表與槽位變化關閉水量收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for backwashing and net water balance. Close the water balance using branch totalizers and tank-level changes. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只報瞬時通量掩蓋頻繁停洗損失。診斷與介入：以分支水表和槽位重建每日收支，避免回收重複計入。~Instantaneous flux hides frequent washing losses. Diagnostic response: Rebuild the daily balance from branch meters/tank levels without double-counting recycle.
units.misconception: 高瞬時通量必定提高每日淨產水。~Higher instantaneous flux always increases daily net production.
units.practice: 只改變 Qbw:12→18 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 220 變為 214 m³/d。用「反洗與淨水量」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qbw:12→18 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 220 to 214 m³/d. Explain the direction using backwashing and net water balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 直接完整性測試~Direct integrity testing
units.mechanism: 完整性檢查針對屏障洩漏，與清洗是否恢復通量是兩件事；測法與門檻依核准系統。~Integrity tests address barrier leakage separately from flux recovery; approved system methods and thresholds govern interpretation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假想隔離測試壓差由 30 降至 28 kPa；時間=2 min。模型 r=(Pstart-Pend)/t，代入得到 1 kPa/min。適用邊界：只計試驗衰減率，不提供膜壓力設定或合格門檻；溫度、洩漏路徑及測試方法須驗證。~Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical isolated-test pressure falls from 30 to 28 kPa over 2 min. Model r=(Pstart-Pend)/t gives 1 kPa/min. Applicability: Test-decay rate only, not a membrane-pressure setting or pass threshold; temperature, leakage paths and method require validation.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「直接完整性測試」的觀測點。校正壓力與時間，記錄溫度並依設備核准方法定位洩漏。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for direct integrity testing. Calibrate pressure/time, record temperature and locate leaks using the approved equipment method. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 通量恢復便跳過完整性試驗。診斷與介入：依核准方法排除溫度和配管洩漏，再評估膜完整性。~Recovered flux leads to skipping integrity testing. Diagnostic response: Rule out temperature/plumbing leakage by the approved method before assessing membrane integrity.
units.misconception: 清洗後滲透率正常就證明沒有破纖。~Normal post-cleaning permeability proves no broken fibers.
units.practice: 只改變 Pend:28→27 kPa，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 1.5 kPa/min。用「直接完整性測試」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Pend:28→27 kPa, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 1.5 kPa/min. Explain the direction using direct integrity testing, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 間接連續監測~Continuous indirect monitoring
units.mechanism: 濁度或粒子監測追蹤異常並觸發進一步確認；不能保證每種微小洩漏都被立即看到。~Turbidity/particle monitoring detects changes that trigger confirmation; it does not guarantee immediate detection of every small leak.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Nin=100000；Nout=100（相同計數單位）。模型 LRV=log10(Nin/Nout)，代入得到 3 log10。適用邊界：需檢測限與回收率；未檢出不能當零。~Original teaching assumptions: Nin=100000; Nout=100 in matching count units. Model LRV=log10(Nin/Nout) gives 3 log10. Applicability: Requires detection limits and recovery; nondetect is not zero.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「間接連續監測」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for continuous indirect monitoring. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把沒有警報當成已完成直接完整性驗證。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。~No alarm is mistaken for completed direct integrity verification. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
units.misconception: 間接監測與直接完整性測試功能完全相同。~Indirect monitoring and direct integrity tests have identical roles.
units.practice: 只改變 Nout:100→1000，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3 變為 2 log10。用「間接連續監測」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Nout:100→1000, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3 to 2 log10. Explain the direction using continuous indirect monitoring, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 清洗恢復與不可逆變化~Cleaning recovery and irreversible change
units.mechanism: 按相容性與已核准程序比較前後正規化滲透率，同時確認完整性，避免把高通量誤認為無損。~Compare normalized permeability under compatible approved cleaning procedures and verify integrity; high flux does not prove an intact membrane.
units.model: 原創教學假設：新膜參考通透率=100；清洗後=90（同單位同溫度）。模型 RF=Lp_after/Lp_reference，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：恢復率不證明膜完整或無化學損傷；須另做完整性／截留檢查。~Original teaching assumptions: Reference permeability=100; post-cleaning=90 at matching units/temperature. Model RF=Lp_after/Lp_reference gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Recovery does not prove integrity or absence of chemical damage; integrity/rejection checks are separate.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「清洗恢復與不可逆變化」的觀測點。將恢復通量與截留、壓差一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cleaning recovery and irreversible change. Compare recovered flux with rejection and pressure loss. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以更強清洗追求通量卻忽略材料老化。診斷與介入：把恢復通透率與截留或完整性證據一起判讀。~Stronger cleaning pursues flux while ignoring material aging. Diagnostic response: Interpret recovered permeability alongside rejection or integrity evidence.
units.misconception: 清洗後通量比新膜更高必定更好。~Flux above the new-membrane value is always better.
units.practice: 只改變 Lp_after:90→80，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.9 變為 0.8 fraction。用「清洗恢復與不可逆變化」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Lp_after:90→80, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.9 to 0.8 fraction. Explain the direction using cleaning recovery and irreversible change, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 後段 RO 保護驗證~Verification of downstream RO protection
units.mechanism: UF 出水仍須分析溶解鹽、可溶有機物及氧化劑等 RO 相容條件；完整前處理鏈需獨立驗證。~UF permeate still requires dissolved-salt, soluble-organic and oxidant checks for RO compatibility; validate the full pretreatment chain.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=100 m³/h；溶解鹽=1000 mg/L。模型 Ms=QC/1000，代入得到 100 kg salts/h。適用邊界：同一離子或同一定義總鹽基準；電導率需水樣特定關係才能轉濃度。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=100 m³/h; dissolved salts=1000 mg/L. Model Ms=QC/1000 gives 100 kg salts/h. Applicability: Use the same ion or defined total-salt basis; conductivity requires a water-specific concentration relationship.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「後段 RO 保護驗證」的觀測點。採進水、產水、濃水並記錄溫度及各離子分析。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for verification of downstream ro protection. Sample feed, permeate and concentrate with temperature and ion analyses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以 UF 濁度合格取代所有 RO 進水分析。診斷與介入：補做離子分析及流量配對，不將電導率無條件換成鹽質量。~Passing UF turbidity replaces all RO feed analyses. Diagnostic response: Add ion analysis and matched flow, avoiding unconditional conductivity-to-salt conversion.
units.misconception: 有 UF 前處理就不會發生 RO 結垢或生物污染。~UF pretreatment prevents all RO scaling and biofouling.
units.practice: 只改變 C:1000→1200 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 100 變為 120 kg salts/h。用「後段 RO 保護驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:1000→1200 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 100 to 120 kg salts/h. Explain the direction using verification of downstream ro protection, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
